# The contract of every item in formal/verus/src, one item per line.
# A spec fn keeps its body, because its definition gives a contract its
# meaning. Any other fn keeps its signature and its requires, ensures and
# decreases clauses. Verus checks its body.
#
# Do not edit this file by hand. A change here shows that a proof now
# states a different property. Rewrite it with:
#   UPDATE_VERUS_CONTRACTS=1 cargo test -p autumn-harvest --test integration \
#     verus_proofs_coverage::every_verus_contract_matches_the_stored_list

## formal/verus/src/dlq_spread.rs
pub open spec fn two64() -> int { 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000 }
pub open spec fn spec_jitter(slot: int, mix: int) -> int { (slot * mix) / two64() }
pub open spec fn saturate(n: int) -> int { if n > u128::MAX as int { u128::MAX as int } else { n } }
proof fn lemma_split(slot: u128) by (bit_vector) ensures slot >> 64 < 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000u128, slot & 0xffff_ffff_ffff_ffffu128 < 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000u128, slot == (slot >> 64) * 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000u128 + (slot & 0xffff_ffff_ffff_ffffu128),
proof fn lemma_shr64(p: u128) by (bit_vector) ensures p >> 64 == p / 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000u128,
proof fn lemma_split_jitter(h: int, l: int, m: int) requires 0 <= h, 0 <= l, 0 <= m, ensures spec_jitter(h * two64() + l, m) == h * m + (l * m) / two64(),
proof fn lemma_jitter_below_slot(slot: int, mix: int) requires 0 <= slot, 0 <= mix < two64(), ensures 0 <= spec_jitter(slot, mix), slot > 0 ==> spec_jitter(slot, mix) < slot, slot == 0 ==> spec_jitter(slot, mix) == 0,
pub proof fn lemma_offset_in_slot(index: int, count: int, window: int, mix: int) requires 0 <= index < count, 0 <= window, 0 <= mix < two64(), ensures ({ let slot = window / count; let offset = slot * index + spec_jitter(slot, mix); &&& slot * index <= offset &&& slot > 0 ==> offset < slot * (index + 1) &&& window > 0 ==> offset < window }),
pub fn spread_offset_nanos(index: u128, count: u128, window: u128, mix: u64) -> (r: u128) requires count > 0, ensures ({ let slot = (window / count) as int; r == saturate(saturate(slot * index) + spec_jitter(slot, mix as int)) }), index < count ==> r == (window / count) as int * index + spec_jitter((window / count) as int, mix as int),

## formal/verus/src/group_commit.rs
pub open spec fn spec_accepts(batch_len: int, max_batch: int, same_tenure: bool, execution_in_batch: bool,) -> bool { batch_len < max_batch && same_tenure &&! execution_in_batch }
pub fn accepts(batch_len: usize, max_batch: usize, same_tenure: bool, execution_in_batch: bool,) -> (r: bool) ensures r == spec_accepts(batch_len as int, max_batch as int, same_tenure, execution_in_batch),
pub fn acknowledges(stage_passed: bool, batch_committed: bool) -> (r: bool) ensures r == (stage_passed && batch_committed), r ==> batch_committed, r ==> stage_passed,
proof fn lemma_share_bounds(queued: int, width: int) requires 0 <= queued <= usize::MAX, 1 <= width, ensures queued % width != 0 ==> queued / width + 1 <= usize::MAX, (queued / width + if queued % width == 0 { 0int } else { 1int }) * width >= queued,
pub fn share(queued: usize, width: usize, max_batch: usize) -> (r: usize) requires max_batch >= 1, ensures 1 <= r <= max_batch, r < max_batch ==> r * (if width == 0 { 1 } else { width }) >= queued,
pub struct Entry { pub tenure: int, pub execution: int, }
pub open spec fn has_execution(queue: Seq < Entry >, batch: Seq < int >, execution: int) -> bool { exists | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() && #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].execution == execution }
pub open spec fn plan_from(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, i: int, batch: Seq < int >,) -> Seq < int > decreases queue.len() - i, { if i >= queue.len() || i < 0 { batch } else if i != own && spec_accepts(batch.len() as int, max_batch, queue [i].tenure == queue [own].tenure, has_execution(queue, batch, queue [i].execution),) { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i + 1, batch.push(i)) } else { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i + 1, batch) } }
pub open spec fn plan(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) -> Seq < int > { if 0 <= own < queue.len() && max_batch >= 1 { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, 0, seq ! [own]) } else { seq ! [] } }
pub open spec fn well_formed(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, batch: Seq < int >) -> bool { &&& 0 <= own < queue.len() &&& 1 <= batch.len() <= max_batch &&& batch [0] == own &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() ==> 0 <= #[trigger] batch [k] < queue.len() &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() ==> #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].tenure == queue [own].tenure &&& forall | j: int, k: int | 0 <= j < k < batch.len() ==> #[trigger] queue [batch [j]].execution != #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].execution }
proof fn lemma_plan_from_keeps_the_rules(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, i: int, batch: Seq < int >,) requires 0 <= i, well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, batch), ensures well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i, batch)), decreases queue.len() - i,
pub proof fn theorem_a_plan_keeps_every_rule(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) requires 0 <= own < queue.len(), max_batch >= 1, ensures well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, plan(queue, own, max_batch)),
pub proof fn theorem_no_leader_plans_nothing(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) requires own < 0 || own >= queue.len() || max_batch < 1, ensures plan(queue, own, max_batch).len() == 0,
pub open spec fn commits(fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool) -> bool { commit_ok && forall | k: int | 0 <= k < fence_errors.len() ==>! #[trigger] fence_errors [k] }
pub open spec fn acked(stages: Seq < bool >, fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool, i: int) -> bool { stages [i] && commits(fence_errors, commit_ok) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_result_depends_on_its_own_stage_and_the_batch(stages: Seq < bool >, fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool, i: int, j: int, other: bool,) requires stages.len() == fence_errors.len(), 0 <= i < stages.len(), 0 <= j < stages.len(), i != j, ensures acked(stages.update(j, other), fence_errors, commit_ok, i) == acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i,), fence_errors [j] ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i), ! commit_ok ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i), ! stages [i] ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i),

## formal/verus/src/jitter.rs
pub fn uniform_inclusive(seed: u64, lo: u64, hi: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures lo <= hi ==> lo <= r && r <= hi,
pub fn full_jitter_nanos(hi: u64, seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r <= hi,
pub fn equal_jitter_nanos(hi: u64, seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures hi / 2 <= r && r <= hi,

## formal/verus/src/mixers.rs
pub open spec fn modulus() -> int { 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000 }
pub open spec fn mul(x: u64, c: u64) -> u64 { ((x as int * c as int) % modulus()) as u64 }
pub open spec fn xs(x: u64, s: u64) -> u64 { x ^ (x >> s) }
pub open spec fn spec_mix64(x: u64) -> u64 { xs(mul(xs(mul(xs(x, 30), 0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9), 27), 0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb), 31) }
pub open spec fn spec_unmix64(y: u64) -> u64 { let d = y ^ (y >> 31) ^ (y >> 62); let c = mul(d, 0x3196_42b2_d24d_8ec3); let b = c ^ (c >> 27) ^ (c >> 54); let a = mul(b, 0x96de_1b17_3f11_9089); a ^ (a >> 30) ^ (a >> 60) }
pub open spec fn spec_splitmix64(seed: u64) -> u64 { spec_mix64(((seed as int + 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) % modulus()) as u64) }
pub open spec fn spec_unsplitmix64(y: u64) -> u64 { ((spec_unmix64(y) as int - 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15 + modulus()) % modulus()) as u64 }
proof fn lemma_xs30(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 30); y ^ (y >> 30) ^ (y >> 60) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 30) ^ (x >> 60); y ^ (y >> 30) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_xs27(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 27); y ^ (y >> 27) ^ (y >> 54) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 27) ^ (x >> 54); y ^ (y >> 27) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_xs31(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 31); y ^ (y >> 31) ^ (y >> 62) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 31) ^ (x >> 62); y ^ (y >> 31) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_mul_inverse(x: u64, c: u64, ci: u64, k: int) requires c as int * ci as int == k * modulus() + 1, ensures mul(mul(x, c), ci) == x,
proof fn lemma_mixer_constants() ensures 0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9int * 0x96de_1b17_3f11_9089int == 8125545580553827436int * modulus() + 1, 0x94d0_49bb_1331_11ebint * 0x3196_42b2_d24d_8ec3int == 2077064247507883091int * modulus() + 1,
pub proof fn lemma_unmix64_inverts_mix64(x: u64) ensures spec_unmix64(spec_mix64(x)) == x,
pub proof fn lemma_mix64_inverts_unmix64(y: u64) ensures spec_mix64(spec_unmix64(y)) == y,
pub proof fn theorem_mix64_is_a_bijection() ensures forall | x: u64, y: u64 | #[trigger] spec_mix64(x) == #[trigger] spec_mix64(y) ==> x == y, forall | y: u64 | spec_mix64(#[trigger] spec_unmix64(y)) == y,
pub proof fn theorem_splitmix64_is_a_bijection() ensures forall | x: u64 | #[trigger] spec_unsplitmix64(spec_splitmix64(x)) == x, forall | x: u64, y: u64 | #[trigger] spec_splitmix64(x) == #[trigger] spec_splitmix64(y) ==> x == y,
pub fn mix64(mut x: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_mix64(x),
pub fn dlq_mix64(seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_mix64(seed),
pub fn splitmix64(seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_splitmix64(seed),

## formal/verus/src/owner_fence.rs
pub fn next_epoch(epoch: i64) -> (r: Option < i64 >) ensures epoch < i64::MAX ==> r == Some((epoch + 1) as i64), epoch == i64::MAX ==> r == None::< i64 >,
pub fn fence_passes(pinned: i64, row: i64, holder_matches: bool) -> (r: bool) ensures r == (holder_matches && pinned == row), pinned < row ==>! r, pinned > row ==>! r,
pub enum LeaseOp { Acquire, Renew, Release, Expire, }
pub open spec fn step(epoch: int, op: LeaseOp) -> int { match op { LeaseOp::Acquire => epoch + 1, _ => epoch, } }
pub open spec fn run(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) -> int decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { epoch } else { run(step(epoch, ops [0]), ops.drop_first()) } }
pub open spec fn acquisitions(ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) -> int decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { 0 } else { let head = match ops [0] { LeaseOp::Acquire => 1int, _ => 0int, }; head + acquisitions(ops.drop_first()) } }
proof fn lemma_run_counts_acquisitions(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) ensures run(epoch, ops) == epoch + acquisitions(ops), acquisitions(ops) >= 0, decreases ops.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_the_epoch_never_falls(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) ensures run(epoch, ops) >= epoch,
pub proof fn theorem_only_an_acquisition_moves_the_epoch(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) requires acquisitions(ops) == 0, ensures run(epoch, ops) == epoch,
pub proof fn theorem_a_takeover_fences_the_old_tenure(pinned: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >, holder_matches: bool,) requires acquisitions(ops) > 0, ensures run(pinned, ops) > pinned, ! (holder_matches && pinned == run(pinned, ops)),
pub open spec fn batch(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >) -> Seq < int > { Seq::new(epochs.len(), | p: int | if locked.contains(p) { step(epochs [p], LeaseOp::Acquire) } else { epochs [p] },) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_is_one_acquisition_per_locked_row(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >, p: int,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures batch(epochs, locked).len() == epochs.len(), locked.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, locked) [p] == run(epochs [p], seq ! [LeaseOp::Acquire]), ! locked.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, locked) [p] == epochs [p],
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_fences_only_its_locked_rows(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >, p: int, holder_matches: bool,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures locked.contains(p) ==>! (holder_matches && epochs [p] == batch(epochs, locked) [p]), ! locked.contains(p) ==> epochs [p] == batch(epochs, locked) [p],
pub open spec fn skip_locked(wanted: Set < int >, takeable: Set < int >, busy: Set < int >) -> Set < int > { wanted.intersect(takeable).difference(busy) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_keeps_each_epoch_under_a_commit(epochs: Seq < int >, wanted: Set < int >, takeable: Set < int >, busy: Set < int >, p: int, pinned: int, holder_matches: bool,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures busy.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p] == epochs [p], busy.contains(p) && holder_matches && pinned == epochs [p] ==> (holder_matches && pinned == batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p]), batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p] != epochs [p] ==> (wanted.contains(p) && takeable.contains(p) &&! busy.contains(p)),
